provenance.subject: the discriminating control: without 1.34.5 published, the same mechanism derives 1.34.5 rather than 1.34.6
provenance.design_reference: docs/aben-design.md section 9, B2: 'Control: fixture without 1.34.5 published -> 1.34.5 derived'
provenance.why_this_control_exists: b2-stale-cli-version.json asserts that the resolver derives 1.34.6. On its own that green is consistent with a resolver that always returns 1.34.6, or that hardcodes next-patch of a constant, or that ignores the fixture entirely. This control differs from the primary in exactly ONE respect - whether 1.34.5 occupies - and must produce a different answer. If both fixtures yield the same version, the instrument is not reading occupancy and the primary's green means nothing.

construction.warning: This is a counterfactual world: 1.34.5 IS published in reality (re-observed 2026-08-14, npm HTTP 200, tag aw-v1.34.5 at 2455e7a127ab5f216477a0af114cb69e5b0caa74). Nothing here is offered as a recorded registry state at the moment of authoring. It is authored to isolate the single variable and must never be presented as one.
construction.derived_from: b2-stale-cli-version.json with every 1.34.5 occupancy and its anchor removed, and nothing else changed
construction.what_is_NOT_counterfactual: the 1.34.4 half. Those values are the primary's, re-observed rather than invented (aw-v1.34.4 at 9cd5cbeb0045fe9bc3821dfe0875efab0f19ae16; @awebai/aw 1.34.4 HTTP 200, both 2026-08-14) - which is what makes this a one-variable control rather than a second constructed world.

why_the_prior_history_stays.rule: the one-difference rule cuts both ways: removing anything the primary carries beyond 1.34.5 is a second difference, and the pair stops isolating the variable it names.
why_the_prior_history_stays.mechanism: aw-cli's derivation is tag-history, so the history below the candidate IS the input. Strip 1.34.4 as well and the engine reads a world in which no CLI ever shipped; it has no predecessor to derive from and reconciles at no version at all. The honest answer to that world is a refusal, not 1.34.5 - so a control emptied that far tests the no-history path while still looking like an occupancy control, and the primary's green stays unguarded.
why_the_prior_history_stays.history: this fixture WAS authored fully empty, and the assembly harness bridged the gap by supplying 1.34.4 from the test body. The bridge is gone: the fixture carries its own world, and the derivation reads every value from it.
